description: Move the text cursor or extend the text selection by characters, words, lines or paragraphs, or to the start or end of the story (the arrow-key and Shift-arrow shortcuts), select the line at the cursor, or select a character range

count.description: move/extend: steps forward (positive) or back (negative); with unit story, positive goes to the end, negative to the start

length.description: select_range: number of characters (0 places the insertion point)

operation.description: move (the insertion point) | extend (the selection) | select_line | select_range

start.description: select_range: first character; move/extend/select_line: the starting position when the story has no selection

story.description: Which story: frameId (any text frame of the story), storyId (from get_document_stories), or selection: true (the story of the selected text or text frame)

frameId.description: Id of a text frame in the story

selection.description: Use the story of the current selection

unit.description: move/extend: step by character, word, line or paragraph, or jump to the story start or end

name: select_text
title: Select Text
